text_simplified: This text cites narrations from the Salaf on disciplining children and orphans, including striking. The jurists restricted it to being light and non-injurious, only after teaching and gradual steps, never resorted to if anything else suffices, away from the face and never in anger, and warned against excess or harming the child. Almorabbi never recommends hitting; better alternatives are dialogue, example, praise, and calm consequences agreed in advance.
